reason: The patch adds an eager `s.Init(ctx)` to `NewResourceServer` (pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:258-262) on a `context.Background()`-derived context with cancel but no deadline (server.go:229). That constructor is reached from the wire provider `ProvideUnifiedStorageClient` (pkg/storage/unified/client.go:67,101; pkg/server/wire.go:212), so a DB migration/ping or search-index build error or hang (server.go:296-311) now fails or stalls startup instead of the first request. "Every process" is slightly overstated: the `unified-grpc` storage type builds only a client (client.go:78-97) and search init is feature-flagged.
